# scripts/Interaction/KeyItem.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/KeyItem.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Frobbable rigid key transferring key_id and its mesh to player.inventory once.
Matching doors/chests can then unlock. It cannot be carried; frob queues deletion.

Base: `RigidBody3D`. Registered class: `KeyItem`.
